title: recreating unreal engine for agents from scratch (wk 1 OSS)
author: make_GTA_yourself
selftext:
hi, kevin here, one of the devs behind [machinesatplay.com](http://machinesatplay.com) , an open source gaming engine for codex/claude code.

**tldr:** its full CLI based and uses rust/bevy for multiplayer. it compiles to wasm, and will have a much higher perf ceiling than three.js and other pure web alternatives. this will let us compile to desktop native, and mobile native (still wip).

would love to get your feedback on what I'm working on! also we open sourced/MIT license the cli and engine at [https://github.com/machinesatplay/machinesatplay](https://github.com/machinesatplay/machinesatplay)
